description: A bubble tea shop sells mango and lychee bubble tea. Each mango bubble tea requires 4 units of mango juice and 8 units of tea. Each lychee bubble tea requires 6 units of lychee juice and 6 units of tea. The shop has available 2000 units of mango juice and 3000 units of lychee juice. At least 40% of the bubble teas made must be lychee flavored. However, mango bubble tea sells better and thus the number of mango bubble teas made must be large than the number of lychee bubble teas made. How many of each bubble tea flavor should be made to minimize the total amount of tea needed?

MangoJuicePerMangoTea.definition: Units of mango juice required to make one mango bubble tea

LycheeJuicePerLycheeTea.definition: Units of lychee juice required to make one lychee bubble tea

TeaPerMangoTea.definition: Units of tea required to make one mango bubble tea

TeaPerLycheeTea.definition: Units of tea required to make one lychee bubble tea

TotalMangoJuice.definition: Total units of mango juice available

TotalLycheeJuice.definition: Total units of lychee juice available

MinLycheePercentage.definition: Minimum percentage of total bubble teas that must be lychee flavored

objective.description: "Minimize the total amount of tea required to produce the mango and lychee bubble teas"

constraints.description: (number of lychee bubble teas) >= (2/3) * (number of mango bubble teas)
(number of mango bubble teas) >= (number of lychee bubble teas)

MangoTeas.definition: Number of mango bubble teas produced

LycheeTeas.definition: Number of lychee bubble teas produced
